Theme 006 · Product UI as the stage

OS Window Choreography

A branded desktop where windows are the cast: dashboards, a deploy log, a chart. They pile up, spread out Exposé-style and genie into the dock, while the camera auto-zooms after the pointer. Acme Pulse is the small utility window that is always on top — and a coral thread ties the deploy to the drop across windows.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Branded window chrome — warm title bars with a coral close dot; each window is an actor.
  • Pulse utility window — small, teal-rimmed, always on top: the agent.
  • Exposé spread — the overview beat: “you have 38 of these”.
  • Cross-window thread — coral bezier tying deploy #2231 to the drop.
  • Pointer + click ring — the human's decision, with auto-zoom following it.
  • Genie minimize + dock — closing the noise; Pulse is the one icon left running.

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Exposé spread — FLIP from stacked to grid, 0.6 s expo.out, 0.04 s stagger from the centre out, landing on the drop.
  • Auto-zoom follow — camera scales to 1.8× on each click and eases back, 0.7 s power2.inOut with light motion blur; clicks are on beats, zoom-outs on the “and”.
  • Genie — each window sliced into 12 strips, scaleX + skew toward the dock with a 0.02 s delay gradient; one window per beat.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Why: “too many windows” is the pain everyone recognises, and a single always-on-top utility is an instant picture of a quiet background agent. The cross-window thread shows the agent connecting sources a human would have to alt-tab between. Risk: copying a real OS too literally feels generic — keep the chrome branded and the wallpaper in your palette.

Adapt to your product: the windows become the tools your customers juggle today; your product is the one utility window that stays on top and the only icon left in the dock.
